dataset_context.dataset_description: Checked-in wording-variance challenge pack used to keep softer suspicion language, optional follow-up recommendations, and inflammatory confounders visible in the public proof surface.
dataset_context.labeling_policy: This deidentified repository sample emphasizes reviewer-visible pancreatic concern, follow-up language, and confounder handling rather than autonomous diagnostic claims. Labels were shaped to preserve the ambiguity a reviewer would still need to inspect.
dataset_context.notes: Repository challenge pack for public proof only. This is not a clinical validation dataset.

bucket_counts.description: Reports with direct lesion or malignant-process wording that should remain easy to justify in a reviewed queue.
Operationally important pancreatic follow-up recommendations that can sound optional enough to miss.
Cases driven by focal fullness, duct change, or hedged occult-lesion language instead of a direct mass declaration.
Clearly nonsuspicious pancreatic reports that should stay out of the flagged queue.
Specificity checks where inflammatory duct prominence risks being overcalled as a suspicious pancreatic signal.

cohort_counts.description: Surveillance MRI cases centered on cyst follow-up language, interval wording, and optional-sounding reimaging recommendations.
Front-door CT cases where softer phrasing and inflammatory change can blur the line between a true pancreatic cue and a confounder.
Navigator-style review cases that mix high-acuity lesion language, equivocal focal fullness, and clearly benign negatives.

cases.label_notes: Softer explicit neoplasm phrasing with tissue recommendation and duct caliber change.
cases.report_excerpt: CT abdomen with contrast: Ill-defined hypoattenuating lesion at the pancreatic tail with upstream duct caliber change. Impression: infiltrative pancreatic neoplasm is suspected; EUS-guided tissue sampling is recommended.
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep softer but still explicit neoplasm suspicion linked to the tissue recommendation.

cases.label_notes: High-acuity neck lesion with malignant process favored and urgent biopsy guidance.
cases.report_excerpt: CT abdomen and pelvis: Hypoenhancing lesion at the pancreatic neck with mild SMV abutment. Impression: malignant pancreatic process is favored; urgent tissue diagnosis is advised.
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep high-acuity lesion language and urgent workup recommendation near the top of the queue.

cases.label_notes: Subtle contour change and distal duct prominence with occult malignancy not excluded.
cases.report_excerpt: CT pancreas protocol: Mild loss of normal lobulation at the pancreatic neck with distal duct prominence. Impression: occult pancreatic malignancy is not excluded; dedicated pancreas protocol CT is recommended.
cases.reviewer_focus: Surface softer not-excluded wording when it rides with focal pancreatic morphology.

cases.label_notes: Focal pancreatic head fullness with abrupt side-branch termination and GI workup advice.
cases.report_excerpt: CT abdomen and pelvis: Focal fullness at the pancreatic head with abrupt termination of an adjacent side branch. Impression: an occult pancreatic lesion remains a concern; GI evaluation and endoscopic correlation are recommended.
cases.reviewer_focus: Flag focal fullness plus abrupt ductal change even when the report hedges on naming a mass.

cases.label_notes: Branch-duct cyst surveillance case with interval septal thickening and a clear MRI follow-up recommendation.
cases.report_excerpt: MRI abdomen: Branch-duct IPMN at the pancreatic body shows mild interval septal thickening without enhancing nodularity. Impression: follow-up pancreas MRI in 6 months is recommended.
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep pancreatic surveillance instructions reviewable even when cancer wording is absent.

cases.label_notes: Acute-on-chronic pancreatitis with transient duct prominence and an explicit denial of a focal mass.
cases.report_excerpt: CT abdomen: Acute-on-chronic pancreatitis with mild main duct prominence and peripancreatic inflammatory change. No focal pancreatic mass is identified.
cases.reviewer_focus: Avoid turning inflammatory duct prominence into a false alarm when mass language is explicitly denied.

cases.label_notes: Optional-sounding surveillance recommendation for stable uncinate cyst cluster that is easy to underrank.
cases.report_excerpt: MRI pancreas surveillance: Small clustered uncinate cysts are unchanged. Impression: consider repeat pancreas MRI in 12 months to document continued stability.
cases.reviewer_focus: Make softer optional-sounding surveillance wording visible enough for review.

cases.label_notes: Incidental fatty pancreatic change without lesion or follow-up recommendation.
cases.report_excerpt: CT abdomen: Mild fatty replacement of the pancreas without ductal dilatation, focal lesion, or peripancreatic stranding.
cases.reviewer_focus: Do not escalate incidental pancreatic fatty change.

cases.label_notes: Clean MRI negative control with a normal pancreas and no recommendation language.
cases.report_excerpt: MRI abdomen: Pancreas is normal in contour and signal without ductal dilatation, focal lesion, or cystic change.
cases.reviewer_focus: Keep clean normal surveillance reads out of the queue.

submission.evaluation_command: python scripts/run_external_eval.py --labels docs/examples/wording-variance-benchmark-sample-labels.jsonl --predictions docs/examples/wording-variance-benchmark-sample-predictions.jsonl --threshold 0.35 --top-k 4 --out-dir docs/examples --basename wording-variance-benchmark-sample-current --manifest docs/examples/wording-variance-benchmark-sample-manifest.json --dataset-name deidentified-wording-variance-challenge-sample --dataset-split challenge --project-name "Pancreatic Signal" --submission-name external-deidentified-wording-variance-challenge-sample --strength "Top-ranked positives still cluster around the most actionable lesion and occult-lesion concern cases." --strength "The pack keeps softer wording and optional-sounding follow-up recommendations visible in the same reviewer-facing proof shape." --limitation "Sample remains small and deidentified for repository use." --limitation "One optional-sounding follow-up case remains missed and one pancreatitis confounder remains overcalled." --notes "Repository challenge pack for public proof only. This is not a clinical validation dataset."
notable_strengths: Top-ranked positives still cluster around the most actionable lesion and occult-lesion concern cases.
The pack keeps softer wording and optional-sounding follow-up recommendations visible in the same reviewer-facing proof shape.
known_limitations: Sample remains small and deidentified for repository use.
